function.name: Services_1_BookAppointment
function.description: This function books an appointment with a specified hair stylist or salon on a given date and time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

stylist_name.description: The name of the hair stylist or salon where the appointment is to be booked.

appointment_time.description: The time for the appointment in 24-hour format (e.g., '14:00' for 2 PM).

appointment_date.description: The date for the appointment in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD' (e.g., '2023-04-15').

function.name: Services_1_FindProvider
function.description: Search for a hair stylist located within a specified city and filter results based on unisex availability. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

city.description: The city where the salon is located, in the format of 'City, State' (e.g., 'Austin, TX'). State names must be abbreviated with two letters.

is_unisex.description: Flag indicating whether the salon caters to all genders. True for yes, False for no.
